Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You watch the shoulder rather than the blade and move before the strike is fully formed.

Rules

Action
Reaction
Attribute
None — no roll
Target / range / shape
Self, before defending against a visible physical attack.
Duration
Resolve once at the stated trigger; applied conditions follow normal decay.
Equipment / acquisition
No item needed unless named above.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Skill

Predict the line of a blow you can see. Use Reason instead of the attack’s printed defense attribute for this defense only. This cannot replace resistance to poison, cold, mental intrusion or another internal threat.
